# Published retained evidence DTO fixture

`backend-v044-retained.json` is synthetic wire data produced by the accompanying Go source through the actual `github.com/datatug/backend v0.44.0` response DTOs and its resolved `datatug-core v0.63.0`. The producer calls Core Result validation and canonical recordset fingerprinting, and serializes both complete-Result and row-evidence digests separately. It intentionally covers a folder-qualified saved query, initial native fence generation zero, Go nil slices and an unattempted NULL cell.

The producer ran successfully with normal published modules in an isolated temporary Go module, without replacements, a workspace, provider listeners or repository dependency changes. It is a codec fixture, not an executed SQL run, source grant, sealed production manifest, or browser acceptance receipt. `fixture-actor` is synthetic attribution. Production authorization is checked again by each retained-open endpoint.
